import ctypes
import os

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function prototype
# double gsl_cdf_weibull_Pinv(const double P, const double a, const double b);
gsl.gsl_cdf_weibull_Pinv.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_cdf_weibull_Pinv.restype = ctypes.c_double

def weibull_pinverse(P, a, b):
    """Compute the inverse CDF for the Weibull distribution."""
    return gsl.gsl_cdf_weibull_Pinv(P, a, b)

    assert weibull_pinverse(1.0, 1.0, 1.0) == float('inf'), "Test case 3 failed"
    assert weibull_pinverse(0.5, 2.0, 2.0) == 1.6651092223153954, "Test case 4 failed"
